name: Chitradurga

service.operator: Revenue Department / Survey Settlement and Land Records, Government of Karnataka; DILRMP dashboard by Government of India Department of Land Resources
service.localCustodianEvidence: Official Chitradurga district directory lists the Deputy Director of Land Records & Survey Settlement (DDLR), Chitradurga.
service.scope: State land-record service and district-level digitization-status dashboard; no citywide parcel inventory was verified.

attempts.outcome: First-party page found and read through discovery; it identifies the local DDLR office.
attempts.evidence: Local government directory/custodian evidence; no parcel schema or geometry.

attempts.outcome: HTTP 200 page observed through first-party web retrieval; dashboard lists Karnataka / Chitradurga and taluk-level cadastral-map, georeferencing, linked-map, parcel and ULPIN status fields.
attempts.evidence: Dashboard reports Chitradurga taluk totals including 217 villages, 188 georeferenced cadastral maps, 90,936 total land parcels, 70,503 georeferenced parcels and 58,617 ULPIN implemented; these are status values, not returned parcel geometries.

attempts.outcome: Direct curl request timed out after 20 seconds; no response body or current JavaScript/configuration was obtained.

schemaAndCrs.fieldMapping: DILRMP table fields are dashboard status metrics, not parcel-feature attributes. No native parcel identity field was returned.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [14.2258717885653, 76.4002120919787] is preserved in latitude/longitude order; it was not shifted to force a parcel hit.
The local DDLR directory entry establishes custodian evidence, not an open parcel endpoint.
DILRMP aggregate digitization/ULPIN status is not city boundary coverage and is not parcel geometry.
A timeout, TLS verification failure, map extent miss, login wall, or zero exact-point hit would not prove citywide absence.
No source integration, runtime admission, or citywide absence claim is made.
uncertainty: The public Karnataka viewer may require a village/revenue-map workflow or additional client-side routes that could not be inspected after the direct timeout. Further research would need a reachable public route and must continue to exclude personal and ownership fields.
